notes:
The popup's packs and groups can be folded and opened from the keyboard, and the manager's sidebar is as wide as you drag it. Builds on [v0.2.20](https://github.com/bekalpaslan/promptline/releases/tag/v0.2.20).

### Popup

- **Every pack and group header is an arrow stop.** ↑↓ step onto a header above its rows; Enter folds or opens it, ← folds an open one, → opens a folded one or steps onto its first row, and ← on a folded group folds its pack. Until now the arrows moved over prompts only, so a folded section could be reopened from the keyboard only with Ctrl+→, which opened everything, and with everything folded ↑↓ did nothing.
- **← on a prompt leaves the selection on the fold it made**, so → undoes it at once. Opening a header keeps the selection on it instead of jumping to the top of the list. The hint bar reads **fold** or **unfold** while a header is selected.
- **A header no longer reads as a prompt.** A pack's name sits on a grey band that stays at the top of the list while its prompts scroll, so you always see which pack you are in; a group's name is a divider with a rule to its count.
- **The selected row has a bar at its left edge**, in the list and in the action panel. In dark mode the highlight alone read as a stray green row rather than as the cursor.

### Manager

- **Drag the sidebar's right edge to make it wider or narrower.** The width is remembered; double-click the edge for the default. From the keyboard, Tab to the edge and use ← and →. The sidebar gives the editor its room back when the window gets smaller.
